## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak sector breadth with only Technology/Healthcare/Materials positive and a narrow leadership skew to Technology; plus major divergence among large caps (e.g., META/INTC/QCOM ABOVE TREND vs GOOGL TREND EXHAUSTION and AMZN BELOW TREND) — consequently no strong directional signal. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Style: Growth/Momentum mixed.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology lead: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare steady: PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL. Materials modest: FCX not listed in detail but sector 1W +0.71% — Materials showing internal rotation.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +1.52%) TREND EXHAUSTION, CVX (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +2.12%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND; WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND; FDX (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) TREND EXHAUSTION; PSX (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +5.58%) TREND EXHAUSTION — weakness concentrated in Utilities/Industrials/Select Energy.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — watch SHOP and AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL for short-term distribution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech shows short-term strength led by chip and ad names but internals narrow; AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.53% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth estimate: 15/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are center-left: SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -5.15%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Sector breadth estimate: 3/20 positive; cyclicals not broadly leading.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed but supportive defensively: JNJ (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Sector breadth estimate: 10/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Neutral stance: favor taking selective exposure to proven short-term tech leaders (QCOM, INTC, META) while reducing exposure to lagging Utilities/weak Financials (NEE, SCHW); monitor SHOP/AMGN as tactical reversal candidates. Style: Growth/Momentum mixed; keep position sizing disciplined given narrow leadership and divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (estimate 15/24 positive) — watch chip and ad names for continuation. Healthcare (estimate 10/17 positive) as defensive ballast.  
BEARISH: Energy (estimate 2/10 positive) and Utilities (estimate 1/10 positive) — monitor earnings/news sensitivity; Financials (estimate 3/20 positive) for credit/earnings risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
QCOM: sustain 1W momentum (loss of >8% 1W would invalidate follow-through). META: keep ABOVE TREND; failure to hold recent 1W gains (> -6% from current) would signal pullback. ORCL: continued weekly losses below -7% confirm BELOW TREND pressure. NEE: further 1W weakness (-5%+) would extend utility sell-off.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
WBD (+85): Paramount Skydance leveraged loan headline; WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. ABT (+75) present in headlines but not in detailed returns here; watch for confirmation. SLB (+60) headline supportive for Energy contractor exposure but Energy sector internals remain weak.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (-60): 737 MAX software glitch; BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. MPC (-50): political/export risk; MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) TREND EXHAUSTION — price aligns with uncertainty. IBM (-70): serious probe headline — monitor for downside if price begins to follow sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Growth/Momentum mixed. META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and major divergences among megacaps (GOOGL TREND EXHAUSTION, AMZN BELOW TREND) and headline-driven names (WBD bullish, BA bearish) could produce volatile rotation — monitor sentiment vs price for confirmation.
